3693-3836-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Urza, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1355-1432.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-1432.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-1432.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-1432.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1981-2415-5686-6772.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

4050-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2557-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Parallel Lives.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-2557-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

855-2021-2060-4029.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1594-4268-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4268-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2292-2452-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-6633-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-6633-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7267-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Michelangelo and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2523-2869-4771.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Myr Scrapling that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Repeat using the Myr Scrapling token

413-1445-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1308-1558-2638-4231-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-2638-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1336-1978-5776.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat

3490-4369-4659-6235.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4369-4659-6235.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Agate Instigator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Agate Instigator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

527-4359-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

967-3809-5147-6753-7087.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

339-677-955-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4616-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

586-2393-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1718-2018-4053.description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1117-1796-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-1987-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Warden of the Eye.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1251-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1251-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

465-719-1115-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-1115-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2493-5195-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Archaeomancer
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Splash Portal to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

372-2556-3306.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
372-2556-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

372-1987-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1987-5913.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1715-1744-2836-3994.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two other Golems on the battlefield.
1715-1744-2836-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Fleeting Distraction by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Fleeting Distraction targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Fleeting Distraction, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 8 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.

3263-3501-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Aspect of Mongoose, adding {2}.
Aspect of Mongoose triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Aspect of Mongoose by paying {2}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat.

974-1953-3750.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-1953-3750.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing all tokens you control to become copies of the Smaug token.
Put all but one Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Myr dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4302-4509.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

91-4968-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-4968-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2302-3108-3374-5158.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, targeting another creature.
Repeat until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Grim Poppet persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grim Poppet, adding {C}{C}.
Grim Poppet dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of four -1/-1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3542-4115.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
You have no other Illusions on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
3542-4115.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The token Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
The nontoken Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the token Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-2634-3351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Orc and/or Shaman.
2440-2634-3351.description:
Cast Through the Breach by paying {4}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Through the Breach.
Resolve the copy of Through the Breach, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Rootha enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
 If you control two other Orcs and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
